options.reason: The table is a transactional retail ledger with no column that functions as a per-row scientific outcome, so the defensible study is segmenting the entity the ledger is about: customers. Rows are line items, so features (recency, frequency, monetary value, basket diversity, country) are aggregated to the CustomerID level and clustering is applied there, with CustomerID set as the group column so all rows of a customer stay in one partition. No target exists, hence no leakage suspects; InvoiceNo and StockCode are record/product codes that must not be used as features. Timestamps are used only to derive recency-style static features, so time_columns is left empty per the clustering-from-transactions rule.
options.title: clustering
